question: The Lingraja temple of Odisha is built in the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Nagar style of architecture**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Lingraja temple of Odisha is built in the **Nagar style of architecture**.
 
• The Nagar style, also known as North Indian style, is characterized by its beehive-shaped tower (Shikhara) and intricate carvings.
 
• It stands as a significant example of Kalinga
